mainEntity.name: How often should I wash my car?

acceptedAnswer.text: For regular city driving, washing your car every 1–2 weeks helps remove road dust, dirt and surface contaminants. Frequency may vary depending on weather, parking conditions and daily usage.

mainEntity.name: What is included in a foam car wash?

acceptedAnswer.text: A foam wash uses a pre-wash foam to loosen surface dirt before the vehicle is carefully cleaned and rinsed. This helps reduce unnecessary contact with the paint during washing.

mainEntity.name: Is foam wash safe for car paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: When performed using suitable automotive cleaning products and proper wash techniques, foam washing is a safe method for routine exterior cleaning.

mainEntity.name: How long does a car wash take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Service time depends on the vehicle size, condition and selected wash package. The TRIEYE team can provide an estimated completion time after inspecting the vehicle.

mainEntity.name: What is ceramic coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic coating is a liquid protective coating applied to prepared vehicle paint. After curing, it creates a durable surface layer that enhances gloss, hydrophobic behaviour and ease of maintenance.

mainEntity.name: How long does ceramic coating last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Durability depends on the coating product, preparation, vehicle usage, environmental exposure and maintenance. Proper aftercare helps the coating perform effectively for longer.

mainEntity.name: Does ceramic coating prevent scratches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic coating can help protect the paint from light environmental contamination and make maintenance easier, but it does not make the vehicle scratch-proof or replace Paint Protection Film for physical impact protection.

mainEntity.name: Does the paint need polishing before ceramic coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paint preparation is important before coating. Depending on the paint condition, cleaning, decontamination and paint correction may be recommended to improve the final finish before the coating is applied.

mainEntity.name: How should I maintain a ceramic-coated vehicle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular gentle washing with suitable automotive products and proper drying techniques helps preserve the coating's gloss and hydrophobic performance.

mainEntity.name: What is graphene coating for cars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graphene coating is an advanced vehicle surface coating designed to enhance paint gloss, slickness, hydrophobic behaviour and ease of maintenance.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between graphene and ceramic coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are protective coating options designed to enhance and protect vehicle paint. Their formulation, surface characteristics and maintenance behaviour can differ, so the best option depends on the vehicle and the owner's expectations.

mainEntity.name: Does graphene coating make a car scratch-proof?

acceptedAnswer.text: No coating makes vehicle paint completely scratch-proof. Graphene coating is primarily intended for surface protection, gloss, hydrophobic performance and easier maintenance.

mainEntity.name: Is paint preparation required before graphene coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Proper cleaning and surface preparation are important for coating performance. Paint correction may also be recommended when visible swirls or defects need to be improved before application.

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain graphene coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use proper wash techniques, suitable automotive cleaning products and gentle drying methods. Consistent maintenance helps preserve gloss and water-repellent behaviour.

mainEntity.name: What is paint correction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paint correction is a machine-polishing process used to improve defects such as swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation and dullness in automotive paint.

mainEntity.name: Can paint correction remove all scratches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not every scratch can be safely removed. The achievable correction depends on the depth of the defect and the available clear coat. Deep scratches may require a different repair method.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between polishing and paint correction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic polishing mainly improves gloss, while paint correction involves a more controlled process focused on reducing visible paint defects and improving surface clarity.

mainEntity.name: Should paint correction be done before ceramic or graphene coating?

acceptedAnswer.text: When paint defects are present, correction before coating can improve the surface finish so the protective coating is applied over cleaner and more refined paint.

mainEntity.name: How long does paint correction take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required depends on the vehicle size, paint condition and level of correction required. A detailed inspection is needed for an accurate estimate.

mainEntity.name: What is Paint Protection Film (PPF)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paint Protection Film is a transparent protective film applied over painted vehicle surfaces to help protect them from stone chips, minor abrasions and everyday road exposure.

mainEntity.name: Which parts of a car can be protected with PPF?

acceptedAnswer.text: PPF can be installed on selected high-impact areas such as the bonnet, bumper, mirrors and fenders, or across larger sections of the vehicle depending on the required coverage.

mainEntity.name: Does PPF change the colour of my car?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-quality clear PPF is designed to preserve the appearance of the original paint while adding a protective layer over it.

mainEntity.name: Can PPF protect against stone chips?

acceptedAnswer.text: PPF is specifically designed to provide a physical barrier that can help reduce paint damage caused by small road debris and stone impacts.

mainEntity.name: How should a PPF-protected car be maintained?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular gentle washing and appropriate detailing methods are recommended. Avoid aggressive cleaning techniques around film edges and follow the installer's aftercare instructions.
